Rep consistency

Active months = months with sales above zero. Top account share is measured on the rep's account-level sales (Hospital, Pharmacy branches and Dispensing doctors); Ecommerce has no account detail. Flags: Lumpy = sales in fewer than 75% of the months; Concentrated = one account is 35% or more of the rep's account sales.

Brand shoppers: brand to channel

This device cannot show the 3D view. The SKU and outlook tables below have the numbers.

Walkers and path widths are drawn from sell-out value per brand and channel, so a busier path has more shoppers. They show value, not counted customers: the file has no patient or customer counts.

* partly loaded month, so its growth is understated. Full-year 2026 is year to date only. Growth rows compare the same month in the earlier year.

Key strategy and action by HOA (DM)

Pick an HOA in the dropdown to see its row. Built from the Region, DM, MR and month selected above. Achievement is 2026 as a share of the same months in 2025, because the file has no target.

HOA (DM)Root causeImpact (achievement)Corrective actionPreventive actionTimeline

Root causes are what the sales data shows (accounts, reps, brands, channels). The reason behind each, such as stock, distributor inventory, PO or tender timing, still needs checking with the team. August 2026 is only partly loaded in the source. Timeline counts from today.

Distribution world

This device cannot show the 3D world. The routes table below has the same numbers.

Trucks, boxes, building heights and road widths are drawn from sell-out value (distributor sell-out to each channel), so a busier road has more trucks. The sales file has no stock, delivery or shipment data, so the trucks are an illustration of value, not real deliveries.
